title: Fixed Radial Guard and Tilted Three Blade Desk Fan
description: One newly authored complete static tabletop-fan exterior. A broad flat-bottom oval base carries a full rising neck and one transverse pivot pin. The complete short head is fixed tilted upward twelve degrees about that pin. Three entire swept broad blades surround a full central hub inside a complete front and rear radial-wire cage with intermediate hoops and a common outer rim. A whole rear motor-case exterior, complete pivot end caps, blank front badge, raised rear knob and one blank base control complete the unit. All numerical geometry is new, no mining-fan rotor, bellmouth, skid or hood-dryer caster stand is imported or split. The short two-sided wire cage on an elevated table pedestal is structurally distinct from a thick duct housing on ground skids or a downward open salon hood. Three opaque untextured PBR roles; one model zero scenes. Metres native Z up and whole bounds-centred ground datum. Static artistic exterior only: no electricity, motor, airflow, cooling, oscillation, pitch adjustment, guarding or blade safety, voltage, load, ergonomics, manufacture or certified performance. Interior wiring, electrical supply, rigging, animation and interaction not made.
